title: Scaling Agricultural Policy Interventions
abstract: Policies aimed at raising agricultural productivity have been a centerpiece in the fight against global poverty. Their impacts are often measured using field or quasi-experiments that provide strong causal identification, but may be too small-scale to capture the general equilibrium (GE) effects that emerge once the policy is scaled up. We propose a new approach for quantifying large-scale GE policy counterfactuals that can both complement and be informed by evidence from field and quasi-experiments. We develop a quantitative model of farm production, consumption and trading that captures important features of this setting, and propose a new solution method that relies on rich but widely available microdata. We showcase our approach in the context of a subsidy for modern inputs in Uganda, using variation from field and quasiexperiments for parameter estimation. We find that both the average and distributional impacts of the subsidy differ meaningfully when comparing a local intervention to one at scale, even for the same sample of farmers, and quantify the underlying mechanisms. We further document new insights on how GE forces differ as a function of saturation rates at different geographical scales, and on the importance of capturing a granular economic geography for counterfactual analysis.
abstract_zh: 旨在提高农业生产率的政策，一直是全球减贫斗争的核心。这些政策的影响通常通过田间试验或准实验来衡量，这些方法具有较强的因果识别力，但其规模可能过小，无法捕捉政策扩大实施后出现的一般均衡（GE）效应。我们提出了一种新方法，用于量化大规模一般均衡政策的反事实结果，该方法既可以补充田间试验和准实验的证据，也可以由其提供信息。我们构建了一个关于农业生产、消费和贸易的定量模型，该模型刻画了这一情境的重要特征，并提出了一种依赖于丰富但广泛可得的微观数据的新求解方法。我们以乌干达现代农业投入品补贴为例展示了该方法，并利用田间试验和准实验的变异进行参数估计。我们发现，即使对于同一批农户样本，当比较局部干预与大规模实施时，补贴的平均影响和分配影响也存在显著差异，并量化了其背后的机制。我们还揭示了一般均衡力量如何随不同地理尺度上的饱和率而变化，以及捕捉精细的经济地理格局对于反事实分析的重要性。

title: Search Costs, Intermediation, and Trade: Experimental Evidence from Ugandan Agricultural Markets
abstract: We study the large-scale experimental rollout of a platform that reduced search and matching frictions in Ugandan agricultural markets by connecting buyers and sellers. Market integration improved substantially: trade increased and price gaps fell. Interpreting the experiment through a trade model, we estimate treatment effects accounting for equilibrium changes that impact control markets. The intervention reduced fixed trade costs by 21% and increased trade flows between treated markets by 6% and across all markets by 1%. Scale economies shaped engagement: few farmers used the platform, but equilibrium price convergence from improved arbitrage by larger traders passed through to farm revenue. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个平台的大规模实验性推广，该平台通过连接买方和卖方，减少了乌干达农产品市场中的搜寻与匹配摩擦。市场一体化得到显著改善：贸易增加，价格差距缩小。通过贸易模型来解释该实验，我们估计了处理效应，并考虑了影响对照市场的均衡变化。该干预使固定贸易成本降低了21%，处理市场之间的贸易流量增加了6%，所有市场之间的贸易流量增加了1%。规模经济塑造了参与程度：只有少数农民使用了该平台，但由于较大规模的商人改善了套利，价格均衡趋同，这一变化传导至农户收入。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

Competition and Entry in Agricultural Markets: Experimental Evidence from Kenya
abstract: African agricultural markets are characterized by low farmer revenues and high consumer food prices. Many have worried that this wedge is partially driven by imperfect competition among intermediaries. This paper provides experimental evidence from Kenya on intermediary market structure. Randomized cost shocks and demand subsidies are used to identify a structural model of market competition. Estimates reveal that traders act consistently with joint profit maximization and earn median markups of 39 percent. Exogenously induced firm entry has negligible effects on prices, and low take-up of subsidized entry offers implies large fixed costs. We estimate that traders capture 82 percent of total surplus. (JEL L13, O13, Q11, Q12, Q13)
abstract_zh: 非洲农产品市场的特征是农民收入低、消费者食品价格高。许多人担心，这一差距在一定程度上是由中间商之间的不完全竞争所驱动的。本文提供了来自肯尼亚的关于中间商市场结构的实验证据。我们利用随机的成本冲击和需求补贴来识别市场竞争的结构模型。估计结果显示，商人的行为与联合利润最大化一致，并获得39%的中位数加成率。外生诱导的企业进入对价格的影响可以忽略不计，而补贴性进入机会的低接受率意味着固定成本很高。我们估计，商人攫取了总剩余的82%。（JEL L13, O13, Q11, Q12, Q13）
